steps.en: Officer opens a page for post-dating days of letters
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman pengaturan hari post-dating surat
steps.why_en: No page is dedicated to post-dating; officers must use the general parameter list.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada halaman khusus post-dating; officer harus memakai daftar parameter umum.

steps.en: Officer changes the number of post-dating days for a letter type
steps.id: Officer mengubah jumlah hari post-dating untuk satu jenis surat

steps.en: Letter date is set days after the file goes to the printer
steps.id: Tanggal surat ditetapkan beberapa hari setelah file dikirim ke percetakan
steps.why_en: Date counts from the generation run, not sending; generation is manual and printer upload is off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Tanggal dihitung dari saat run pembuatan, bukan pengiriman; pembuatan manual dan pengiriman ke percetakan dimatikan di setting produksi.

steps.en: The same post-dating setting applies to court summonses
steps.id: Pengaturan post-dating yang sama berlaku untuk court summons
steps.why_en: The program only prints reminder and demand letters; no court summons printing was found.
steps.why_id: Program hanya mencetak surat reminder dan demand; pencetakan court summons tidak ditemukan.

steps.en: A changed value is used on the next run without new software
steps.id: Nilai yang diubah dipakai di run berikutnya tanpa software baru
